claim: Foot Locker Belgium BV's statutory accounts show its owned Belgian FL stores falling 20 -> 17 -> 14 (Dec-2023, Dec-2024, Dec-2025), about -15% in 2024 and -18% in 2025. Belgian net revenue fell 20.4% in 2025 and average FTE fell 15%. The Luxembourg branch held at 6 stores, with sales down 10%.
data_point: Belgian stores 20 (12/23) -> 17 (12/24) -> 14 (12/25). The scraper's 22 at 12/22 comes from the FY22 deposit, which was not re-fetched. Closed in 2025 (list comparison): one of two Liege stores, Namur, Hasselt. Belgian net revenue EUR 39.04M -> 31.08M (-20.4%); Luxembourg EUR 16.24M -> 14.61M (-10.0%). Average FTE 175 -> 156.1 -> 132.6. 2025 profit rose 'due to better cost control'. Rent bank guarantees Belgium EUR 1.49M, Luxembourg EUR 0.30M. 2025 losses on disposal of fixed assets only EUR 8K. Consolidating parent: Dick's Sporting Goods, Inc. (Coraopolis). The directors' report says no circumstances could materially affect the company's development. The board proposes paying the Luxembourg branch's distributable reserves up to the Belgian head office.
source_name: NBB Central Balance Sheet Office, Foot Locker Belgium BV (KBO 0442.407.102), FY2025 deposit; compared with the FY2024 (fd67457c...) and FY2023 (d5243e83...) deposits
original_quote: Op 31 december 2025 had de vennootschap 14 Foot Locker winkels in België ... Aan het eind van 2025 waren er zes Foot Locker winkels in Luxemburg: 2 winkels in Esch-sur-Alzette en 4 winkels in Luxemburg Stad.
english_translation: At 31 December 2025 the company had 14 Foot Locker stores in Belgium ... At the end of 2025 there were six Foot Locker stores in Luxembourg: 2 in Esch-sur-Alzette and 4 in Luxembourg City.
verifier_note: Downloaded all three NBB PDFs (FY23-FY25) and extracted the text. Verified the store sentences (20/17/14 BE; 6 LU in both FY24 and FY25), the geographic revenue split, FTE 175/156.1/132.6, the cost-control sentence, the no-material-circumstances sentence and DKS as consolidating parent. The 2024 closures (Leuven, the second Mons store) and part of the 2025 closures happened under FL management before the deal, so this is a trend across the deal, not only DKS-era decisions. KBO (06/10/2026) shows 13 active establishment units. That may be one fewer than the 14 stores, but KBO units lag and may include the HQ, so it is not evidence of a 2026 closure. The BE+LU fleet of 20 stores is about 3.6% of FL Europe's 559, so the pace may not generalise. Not in KNOWN_BRIEF, the baseline or other confirmed files.

claim: FL's Spanish holding company Foot Locker Europe Holdings, S.L.U. was merged across the border into its 100% parent, Foot Locker Dutch Holdings B.V. Neither company has employees. This is the first DKS-era legal-entity simplification of the FL Europe holding chain found. It fits preparing a single European perimeter, but it equally fits a routine tax/admin cleanup.
data_point: Common merger plan signed 2026-03-20. Deposited at the Barcelona registry 2026-04-15 (BORME notice 2026-04-22). Approved by the sole shareholder of the absorbed company 2026-05-18 and unanimously by the Dutch absorbing company's general meeting 2026-06-16. Notice signed in Barcelona 2026-06-18 by Larisa Love Chaleff as joint director. This is an upstream merger: the absorbing company already owned all shares of the absorbed company.
original_quote: decidieron aprobar la fusión transfronteriza intracomunitaria por absorción de la Sociedad Absorbida por parte de la Sociedad Absorbente ... se deja constancia de que ninguna de dichas sociedades tiene trabajadores.
english_translation: [they] decided to approve the intra-EU cross-border merger by absorption of the absorbed company by the absorbing company ... it is recorded that neither company has employees.
verifier_note: Downloaded the PDF from boe.es and extracted the text. All dates, the parties, the no-employees statement and the signatory match. Downgraded from A to B: folding a 100%-owned intermediate holding with no staff into its parent is common post-acquisition housekeeping, and nothing in the notice states a purpose. The 'carve-out perimeter' reading is inference only. Not in KNOWN_BRIEF, the baseline or other confirmed files.

claim: Spain's registry gazette (BORME Section A, Barcelona) records Foot Locker Europe Holdings SL's dissolution by merger, registered 2026-08-28, completing the holding-chain collapse into Foot Locker Dutch Holdings B.V. Earlier entries: Peter Scaturro, named to DKS's FL North America team at the close, replaced Michael Andrew Baughn as joint director of the holding (registered 2026-01-08); creditors and worker representatives were notified of the merger plan (registered 2026-04-15); and Reid Joshua Sigal, a DKS veteran who is now COO of FL EMEA, replaced EMEA finance head Gozde Sen Lonell as director and chair of the Spanish operating company Foot Locker Spain SL (registered 2026-08-25).
data_point: Other entries: FL Spain SL board 2025-10-07 (Petersson out as director and chair; Stella Papadopoulou appointed director; Amperse appointed secretary; Sen Lonell appointed chair). KPMG Auditores appointed auditor 2025-12-12; KPMG was also appointed in Oct-2024, so this is a re-appointment, not a change. Joint powers of attorney of Tomas Petersson and Paul William Olson revoked 2026-03-23.
original_quote: FOOT LOCKER EUROPE HOLDINGS SL. Disolución. Fusion. Datos registrales. S 8 , H B 395529, I/A 31 (28.08.26). | FOOT LOCKER SPAIN SL. Revocaciones. CONSEJERO: GOZDE SEN LONELL. PRESIDENTE: GOZDE SEN LONELL. Nombramientos. CONSEJERO: REID JOSHUA SIGAL. PRESIDENTE: REID JOSHUA SIGAL. ... I/A 127 (25.08.26).
english_translation: FL Europe Holdings SL: dissolution, merger, registered 28-Aug-2026. | Foot Locker Spain SL: removed Gozde Sen Lonell as director and chair; appointed Reid Joshua Sigal as director and chair, registered 25-Aug-2026.
verifier_note: Fetched all 7 BORME-A pages live from boe.es; every quoted entry matches verbatim. Correction: issue 172 was published around 7-Sep-2026, while 28-Aug-2026 is the registration date. Scaturro appears in the baseline (BL01/BL09) as part of the FL NA team named at the close, which supports the 'DKS-side officer' reading. Sigal's identity and Sen Lonell's 17-Jun-2026 exit are already in the confirmed UK file (B_w1_registry-uk-ie); the Spanish holding dissolution and the FL Spain chair change are the new parts. Tier B: corporate governance, not a sale or closure signal.

claim: Foot Locker Belgium's board was fully replaced around the deal. EMEA GM Tomas Petersson left effective 2025-08-01, before the close; Erik Jan Amperse joined 2025-10-23; EMEA finance head Gozde Sen Lonell's mandate ended 2026-06-17; DKS veteran Reid Sigal joined 2026-08-03. The current board is Amperse and Sigal only.
data_point: KBO (data date 06/10/2026): directors Erik Jan Amperse since 23-10-2025 and Reid Sigal since 03-08-2026. FY2025 NBB accounts director table: Amperse 2025-10-23 to 2026-07-31 (then reappointed per the scraper); Sen Lonell 2023-09-13 to 2026-06-17; Petersson 2023-09-13 to 2025-08-01. The scraper says Sigal also holds posts in Germany (RPG.com GmbH) and Hungary and that Sen Lonell is now CFO of Douglas BeNe; both are unverified.
source_name: KBO Public Search (06/10/2026); NBB FY2025 accounts director list; Belgisch Staatsblad 2026-08-17 ref 26104970 and 2026-07-23 ref 26094626 (not re-fetched)
original_quote: Goedkeuring van de benoeming van de heer Reid Joshua Sigal als bestuurder van de Vennootschap met onmiddellijke ingang
english_translation: Approval of the appointment of Mr Reid Joshua Sigal as director of the company with immediate effect
verifier_note: KBO page fetched live: Amperse since 23-10-2025 and Sigal since 03-08-2026. The NBB FY25 PDF director table confirms the Petersson and Sen Lonell mandate end dates. The Staatsblad PDFs returned HTML or reset errors, so the Dutch quote is the scraper's, unverified. The Douglas BeNe role and the German/Hungarian posts could not be checked (LinkedIn and companyhouse.de/openregister blocked; search budget exhausted), so they are left out of the claim. Downgraded to C: the same people moves (Petersson out 1-Aug-2025, Sen Lonell out 17-Jun-2026, Sigal as DKS-bred COO EMEA being installed as officer) are already CONFIRMED in B_w1_registry-uk-ie. Belgium is a parallel instance of that re-papering.

claim: Company.info, citing KvK data, flags a management change on 2026-10-02 at Foot Locker Europe B.V. (KvK 23067735, Utrecht), FL's EMEA head, holding and intra-group finance entity. The names are behind a paid extract.
data_point: Management listed: E. Amperse (from 2025) plus 4 other persons or entities. SBI codes 46496, 64210 (financial holding), 64220 (group financing), 47633. Owner: FLE Holdings Cooperatief U.A., which is not on DKS's FY25 Exhibit 21 per the UK file. Address: Stationsplein 32, Utrecht.
original_quote: Organisatie heeft wijzigingen in het management (02-10-2026)
english_translation: The organisation has changes in its management (02-10-2026)
verifier_note: Page fetched live: the change flag, the management line, the SBI codes and the owner match. Tier C: we cannot tell who joined or left. Given the Oct-2025 to Aug-2026 re-papering seen in BE, ES, UK and FR, this is most likely another routine director change. Buying the KvK extract would settle it. Not in the baseline.

claim: The Luxembourg branch of Foot Locker Belgium (RCS B39434) made 4 'Modification' filings with the Luxembourg Business Registers in 2026 (31-Mar, 28-Apr, 30-Jul, 11-Sep) plus a NACE-code update (9-Aug), against 1-2 a year in 2023-2025. The Luxembourg locator still shows 6 stores, matching the Dec-2025 count, so there are no Luxembourg closures so far.
data_point: Filings: 2026 Modifications L260079455, L260105987, L260223548, L260371724; NACE update L260244062 (09.08.2026). Earlier: 2025 one Modification (05.09.2025) plus an ID update; 2024 two; 2023 one. Locator: 6 stores (Esch 1, Luxembourg 4, 'Luxemburg' 1).
source_name: Pappers.lu mirror of Luxembourg Business Registers; stores.footlocker.lu/fr/browse/
verifier_note: Pappers.lu fetched live. Correction: the 09.08.2026 filing is a NACE-code update, not a Modification, so there are 4 Modifications in 2026, not 5. The Luxembourg locator fetched live shows 6 stores. The notice texts were not retrieved; the timing tracks the Belgian head-office director changes (Sen Lonell out Jun-2026, Sigal in Aug-2026), so most likely legal-representative updates. Tier C: no closure or sale content.
